notes.title: New Life of Aged Town Demo Available on February 23rd at 7:00 PM PST!
notes.content:
Dear Town Managers, the long-awaited New Life of Aged Town is finally here!

[b]On February 23th, 2025, at 7:00 PM PST our elderly care-themed game New Life of Aged Town (Demo version) will be available for free on Steam![/b] Thank you for your patience and support!

The demo version lasts approximately 40-60 minutes. It's completely free to play, and we encourage you to download and try it out! If you encounter any issues, feel free to share your feedback, and we'll do our best to improve the game. If you enjoy the demo, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

[b]—Game Introduction—[/b]
New Life of Aged Town is a relaxing and casual game that combines elements of healing, simulation, and educational content.

In the game, you will play as the manager of an elderly town, responsible for building and managing this warm and cozy community. By interacting with the residents and listening to their wishes, you'll gradually improve the town's facilities and create an ideal living environment for the elderly.

What sets this game apart is that it's not just a simulation; it also includes educational content about elderly care, aging society, and elderly mental health. As you play, you'll learn valuable insights into these topics in a lighthearted and engaging way.

[b]—Game Features—[/b]
·Heartwarming and Healing Art Style: Featuring hand-drawn illustrations that provide a warm and comforting visual experience.

·Rich Resident Interactions: Every resident has unique personalities and needs, allowing you to build meaningful relationships with them.

·Casual Simulation Gameplay: Manage the town's development, fulfill the elderly residents' needs, and create the perfect retirement community.

·Fun Educational Elements: Learn more about elderly care, aging, and prepare for your own future while playing.

Download the demo now! We look forward to experiencing this heartfelt town with you!

notes.title: New life of Aged Town | Let's Take a Brief Look at Muccy's New Game Today!"
notes.content:
"New life of Aged Town" 

is a game that our team initiated 22 years ago. 

The initial concept for this game was to allow players to gain insights into the challenges of elderly life, understand the real needs of seniors, and apply the understanding gained in the game to communication with their own family members. 

It is a heartwarming and meaningful game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752770/c32546870f2533ad7ac004548ce1b05b00b55043.jpg[/img]

Through continuous research, development, and feedback collection, our upcoming focus will be on enhancing the details of the storyline, optimizing gameplay experience, and completing the music, sound effects, and animations. The game's development is nearing completion, and we hope to present a better product by optimizing more content details.

Many friends are curious about when our game will be released. Although we cannot provide an exact answer at the moment, we anticipate a release in 2024. 

We hope everyone continues to follow and support our game. Thank you very much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752770/595b2b144ac3dfc69499735d9f77fa75850ea14d.png[/img]

About "New life of Aged Town":

In "New life of Aged Town," you will embark on a new journey in life, interacting with a diverse group of elderly individuals. As you arrive in this aging and declining town alongside the residents, you'll take on the role of the mayor's assistant, helping to revitalize the town.

In the game, you will form emotional connections with various elderly characters, learn about their interests, listen to their life reflections, and experience the many facets of life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752770/566d3f05fd2d13c41a8998d6cc25fa324986f8db.png[/img]

 Each resident is a unique and vibrant individual with their own social and entertainment preferences; they will experience troubles, illnesses, and even pass away.

The gameplay is relaxing and leisurely throughout, where you'll be responsible for town development, striving to fulfill the various wishes of the elderly, hiring caregivers to attend to deteriorating health, and establishing medical plans for those nearing the end of their lives. Gradually, you will transform this aging city into a harmonious and livable community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752770/6cf1ed6f8d834f5cc74b61ccaf89b4e255b6a7ce.png[/img]

At the same time, the game won't forget our team's tradition, incorporating some fun educational elements into the story. You will gain interesting knowledge about the elderly while being entertained.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752770/76a70e06ae5b353e02afc178b29a818d2380de68.png[/img]

This game delves into various topics, such as urban aging, dignified death, caregiver resource shortages, elderly poverty, and dementia. Despite appearing distant, these topics are closely related to our lives.

The exquisite hand-drawn art style adds charm to the game, with warm tones creating a beautiful and cozy city for the elderly.

 "New life of Aged Town" will take you into a game full of warmth and human care, allowing you to spend a healing and heartwarming time with these lovely elderly characters.
